what: Frozen inputs of the RLN-5 map job (jobs/rln5_map.py): the stored answers of T1 and T2, one JSONL row per MATH-500 problem. Not committed (raw generations); uploaded to the Modal Volume iterate-runs with `modal volume put`. The job asserts sha256 and size.
note: The sha256 values are the ones recorded in results/rln4/t1_t2_items-01/run.json for the same two files.

T1.jsonl.what: base with cue, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 (RLN-4 T1)

T2.jsonl.what: RL, plain prompt, T 1.0 / top-p 1.0 (RLN-4 T2)
